# Incident Report: S-TUN-006 Power Failure

- **Classification:** incident
- **Root cause:** power_failure at `S-TUN-006`
- **Confidence:** high (The direct alarm chain shows mains failure, battery low, and site down events on the affected node. Timing aligns with KPI drops, and maintenance, changes, and external events were checked and ruled out.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-25 13:00 to 2026-09-25 17:15
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-25 11:19
- **Affected:** S-TUN-006

## Summary

A mains failure at site S-TUN-006 led to battery exhaustion and a complete site outage.

Site S-TUN-006 experienced a complete service outage with zero availability, active users, and download volume starting at 13:00 and recovering by 17:15 on September 25, 2026.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-25 11:19: Major MAINS_FAILURE alarm raised on S-TUN-006. [ALM-000573]
- 2026-09-25 12:55: Major BATTERY_LOW alarm raised on S-TUN-006. [ALM-000574]
- 2026-09-25 13:00: Anomaly detection indicates availability drop on S-TUN-006. [T1, ANM-000322, T6]
- 2026-09-25 13:10: Critical SITE_DOWN alarm raised on S-TUN-006. [ALM-000575]
- 2026-09-25 17:04: MAINS_FAILURE, BATTERY_LOW, and SITE_DOWN alarms cleared on S-TUN-006. [ALM-000573, ALM-000574, ALM-000575]
- 2026-09-25 17:15: KPI recovery observed for S-TUN-006. [T6]

## Evidence

- Site S-TUN-006 suffered a mains failure starting at 2026-09-25 11:19. [ALM-000573]
- Site S-TUN-006 battery became low at 2026-09-25 12:55. [ALM-000574]
- Site S-TUN-006 went down at 2026-09-25 13:10. [ALM-000575]
- S-TUN-006 KPIs showed complete loss of service between 13:00 and 17:15 on September 25, 2026. [T6, ANM-000322, ANM-000323, ANM-000324]

## Hypotheses

1. **power_failure** at S-TUN-006: confirmed. Direct alarm evidence of mains failure, battery depletion, and site down status perfectly correlates with the KPI outage window. [ALM-000573, ALM-000574, ALM-000575, T6]
2. **planned_maintenance** at S-TUN-006: rejected. No maintenance window was scheduled on the site or its parents during the incident. [T4]
3. **bad_change** at S-TUN-006: rejected. No changes were executed on the site or its parents during the incident. [T5]

## Ruled out

- T4: No maintenance window scheduled on S-TUN-006, LNK-TUN-01-C and its parents between 2026-09-25 11:00 and 2026-09-25 18:00.
- T5: No changes on S-TUN-006, LNK-TUN-01-C and its parents between 2026-09-25 11:00 and 2026-09-25 18:00.
- T7: No external events for region TUN between 2026-09-25 11:00 and 2026-09-25 18:00.

## Recommended actions

- Inspect the local power supply and grid stability at site S-TUN-006.
- Verify battery backup health and recharge capabilities to prevent extended outages during future mains failures.
